what: The Next strip at the very end of the page: even after it is fully in view, each further wheel notch fills the bar inside the strip from the left by 2%, and each upward touch swipe by 7%. When full, it moves on to the next page. If the strip leaves the screen again, the bar returns to 0. A bottom strip that naturally carries only people who scrolled all the way down on to the next page

options.step: Share (%) filled per wheel notch (down), default 2
options.touch: Share (%) filled per upward touch swipe, default 7
options.to: Address to go to when full — if none, the first a[href] in the strip, and if that is missing, it only fires fx:next
options.look: If column, a vertical bar (scaleY from the top, .1s ease) — the vertical strip on the Brand activity page
options.fx:next: Event the bar fires when full (detail.to, cancelable) — if you use a handoff like swup or barba, call preventDefault and run your own transition

note: Does not intercept touch (passive) — pushing at the edge still moves the page and only the bar fills

from.where: shared.js bottom next-item strip (.sh-foot) — original baseFooterDirection: when the strip’s lower edge is within the screen, wheel deltaY>At each 0 +2, touchmove up +7, at 100 goes to the next page via swup, off-screen resets to 0. The active page is a vertical bar (scaleY .1s ease)
